mapper.sql: (select pm2.logical_model_code from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id and lm2.is_deleted = 0 order by pm2.id asc limit 1)

(select lm2.model_name from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id and lm2.is_deleted = 0 order by pm2.id asc limit 1)

(select lm2.model_type from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id and lm2.is_deleted = 0 order by pm2.id asc limit 1)

(select lm2.model_family from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id and lm2.is_deleted = 0 order by pm2.id asc limit 1)

m.id, m.provider_account_code, m.model_code, m.upstream_model, m.version, m.base_url, m.remark, m.billing_rule_code, m.status, m.is_deleted, AS logical_model_code, AS name, AS model_type, AS model_family_code, p.name AS provider_name, p.code AS provider_code
from kb_models m left join kb_provider_accounts pa on m.provider_account_code = pa.code left join kb_providers p on pa.provider_code = p.code
mapper.insert: insert into kb_models(provider_account_code, model_code, upstream_model, version, base_url, remark, billing_rule_code, status) values(#{providerAccountCode}, #{modelCode}, #{upstreamModel}, #{version}, #{baseUrl}, #{remark}, #{billingRuleCode}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_models set provider_account_code = #{providerAccountCode}, model_code = #{modelCode}, upstream_model = #{upstreamModel}, version = #{version}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, remark = #{remark}, billing_rule_code = #{billingRuleCode}, status = #{status} where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update kb_models set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update kb_models set is_deleted = 0 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 1
mapper.select: select count(1) from kb_routing_rule_targets where target_type = 'MODEL' and target_code = #{modelCode}
select count(1) from kb_model_pool_items where model_code = #{modelCode}
select count(1) from kb_provider_model_mappings where model_id = #{modelId}
select count(1) from kb_model_api_bindings where model_id = #{modelId}

select count(1) from kb_models where model_code = #{modelCode}
and id != #{excludeId}
